title: Dunya bhula na payegi akbar teri azaan
body:
DUNIYA BHULA NA PAYEGI AKBAR TERI AZAAN
SARWAR KI JAA SHABHI-E-PAYAMBAR TERI AZAAN
AKBAR TERI AZAAN SE HI HUR KO MILI AMAA, ISLAAM KE RAGAO MEIN HAI TERA LAHOO RAWAA, DETE NA GAR AZAAN TO YEH ISLAM THA KAHAA, SARWAR KI JAA SHABHI-E-PAYAMBAR TERI AZAAN
MAIDAN-E-KARBALA MEIN HAI EK HASHR KA SAMAA, NAZRAO MEIN HAI SHA-E-DEEN KI HAR EK SIMT HAI DHUWAA, LASH-E-PISAR KO DHOOND TE HAI SHAH-E-INSOJAA, SARWAR KI JAA SHABHI-E-PAYAMBAR TERI AZAAN
<<DIVIDER>>
SIBT-E-NABI PA KAISI MUSIBAT KI HAI GHADI, QAM HAI KAMAR TO AANKHAO SE BINAYI JA CHUKI, PUR DARD NAUHA SUKHE HUVE LAB PA HAI YAHI, SARWAR KI JAA SHABHI-E-PAYAMBAR TERI AZAAN
KEHTE HAI SHAH GESUAO WALA KIDHAR GAYA, BINT-E-ALI KA GOAD KA PAALA KIDHAR GAYA, AADA BATAO GHAR KA UJALA KIDHAR GAYA, SARWAR KI JAA SHABHI-E-PAYAMBAR TERI AZAAN
ZAKHMI SINAA KI NOOK SE SEENA HAI TERA LAAL, ZINDAA NA REH SAKEGI JO DEKHEGI MAA YE HAAL, RORO KE RUN MEIN KEHTE YEH SHAH-E-KUSH QISAAL, SARWAR KI JAA SHABHI-E-PAYAMBAR TERI AZAAN
KANDHEY PA HAI ZAEEFI KE LAASHEY JAWA UDHAR, QAIMEY KE DAR PA LAILA HAI THHAAME HUVE JIGAR, HAIRAA HAI DEKH KAR YEH MASHIYATH KI BHI NAZAR, SARWAR KI JAA SHABHI-E-PAYAMBAR TERI AZAAN, KADIYAL JAWA BETA LAHOO ME HAI TAR BA TAR , LAILA PACHADEY KHATI HAI SAR APNA PEET KAR, MAZHAR YE ROKE KEHTE HAI SULTAN-E-BEHROBAR, SARWAR KI JAA SHABHI-E-PAYAMBAR TERI AZAAN
